title: Bath inscribed tablet corpus

date.label: 2nd century CE to late 4th century CE

discovery.note: Recovered archaeologically from the Sacred Spring context at the Roman Baths.

summary: A corpus of roughly 130 inscribed lead or pewter tablets, many framed as private prayers concerning perceived injustice or restitution.
uncertainty: The modern label 'curse tablet' does not fully describe the intent of every inscription.
